_how_to_edit: Encounter weights are relative: they don't need to add up to 100, a bigger number just means more often. Set one to 0 to switch it off. 'extras' are independent chances from 0 to 1 per case (0.25 = one case in four). 'atypical_presentation' is the chance that a case is built the way the diagnosis gets missed (MI without chest pain, PE as syncope) instead of the typical way; it is not rolled in complaint mode, where each topic's presentations list already covers those routes. Save the file and the next case uses the new values. 'review': a topic whose last case scored below weak_below (0.7 = 70%) comes back once after_days have passed since that case. 'order': "unseen_first" works through every unseen topic before reviews; "review_first" puts due reviews ahead of unseen topics. 'tiers': a topic may carry a "tier" in its topic file; the weight here says how much more often that tier comes up (3 = three times as often as weight 1). A topic with no tier has weight 1. 'step2_systems': used only when you mix several systems. Each case first draws a Step 2 system with these relative weights (the midpoints of the USMLE Step 2 CK content ranges), among the systems your ticked topic lists actually cover, then picks a topic inside it. 'untagged' is the weight shared by topics that have no step2_system.
